## Description

Plan high-voltage DC electrical safety for lithium-ion cell formation, charging, aging, and large ESS charge/discharge facilities. Busbar LOTO, formation-charger grounding, aging-room interlock, ESS arc-flash boundary, DC arc-flash PPE selection, `전기안전관리자` sign-off per ESCA Art 22.
